task: Publish exact checker authority for nested EST Message expressions so Root-ingress consumers can bind the invocation to the checked occurrence.
observation: The source call-graph prepass retained nested Message nodes with exact message/receiver ExprIds but no caller SpecId. Statement-form Message checking had a later keyed publisher; expression-form `echo message worker.Accept(message worker.Fetch())` did not. The checked expression path now promotes or clones only the prepass row identified by exact message arena/ExprId and validates the resolved handler and per-instance handler SpecId.
impact: The nested message arguments fixture passes checker, Fast Debug, and Native execution in default and Shadow, producing `7`; exact edge drop, duplicate, and perturb hooks all fail closed. The full root-ingress authority script remains blocked later by an unrelated Fast Debug record-constructor identity invariant in `phase28_root_nested_copy_payload.moss`.

resolution.summary: The nested-message authority path is implemented; the broader root-ingress gate still needs the separate constructor consumer repair.

task: Bind one nested Message EST occurrence checked under two concrete caller SpecIds to its separately selected handler bodies.
observation: A source-only prepass edge can be promoted for its first checked caller, but later checks of the same immutable message ExprId under another domain instance have a different handler body SpecId. Copying the first caller's edge is therefore invalid even though its syntax occurrence matches. New caller rows must be constructed from the handler selected in that checker invocation; only same-caller rows can be reused after strict consistency checks.
impact: The routed twin fixture exercises one Relay handler AST routed to two Sink instances. Fast Debug and Native both produce `1 2 1 2` in Default and Shadow; the root-ingress mutation gate executes this control before stopping on the separate nested-copy constructor consumer invariant.
evidence: python3 tests/tooling/check_phase28_root_ingress_capture_authority.py ./build/compiler/moss-dev (routed twin default/shadow and mutation cases completed; later blocked at nested_copy_payload constructor consumer invariant)
